reason: I'd start the free trial since there's no auto-charge, but I've tried enough sleep apps to expect the 14-day comparison to show little difference, and then the free version with no ads is good enough for me. On my income I won't pay monthly for something that just fades the sound out.
objection: Fading out and restarting a sound doesn't sound like it will really get me to sleep faster. It feels like a nicer timer, and I'm not sure a phone on the mattress can tell when I actually fell asleep.
would_change_my_mind: If my own 14-day result showed a clear gap, like falling asleep 10 or more minutes faster on SLEEP:ON nights, I'd pay for the yearly plan.
